topics.topic: Proposed zoning amendments for Spring Town Meeting
topics.resolution: Posted for public review; presentations scheduled to multiple boards and commissions; public forum planned for late November/early December with revisions in December-January and public hearing in March
topics.quote: s. wallace reported that proposed zoning amendments for the spring town meeting are posted on the town website for public review.

topics.topic: ANR Plan approval for 55 Pines Acres Road
topics.quote: george hudson, 35 pine acres road, presented an anr plan involving the transfer of back land from lot 50-25 to three existing house lots. no new building lots are being created.

topics.quote: motion: a. burney to endorse the a&r for 50 page street, anr-26-6. second: a. reid voice vote: aye (4/0).

topics.topic: Site Plan Modification for 149 Summer Street
topics.quote: the applicant requested an increase in the approved number of motor vehicles from 12 to 19. board concerns included missing dimensions, aisle widths, traffic flow, emergency access, and the location of parking spaces.

topics.topic: 10 Parmenter Road Phase 1 Stormwater and Special Permits
topics.quote: the applicant reported that peer review comments had been addressed. the board discussed the common driveway operation and maintenance agreement, construction inspections, erosion and sedimentation control, and project phasing.

topics.topic: 10 Parmenter Road Phase 2 Stormwater and Special Permits
topics.quote: the applicant reported that graves engineering had issued a clean peer review letter. the board discussed the legal agreement framework, construction inspections, phasing, and fire department review of the proposed turnaround.

topics.topic: 860 New West Townsend Road Site Plan Review and Permits
topics.quote: the applicant reported that peer review comments had been addressed. the board discussed site-distance verification after excavation, soil testing for infiltration basin no. 8 after removal of bulk material, driveway pavement thickness, legal documents, and fire department review.
